topic: A fan asks Steven Adams for an autograph, but Adams refuses until the fan says "please".

hook.first_words: This guy doesn't sign autographs unless they say a specific word.
hook.first_frame: A boy holding a marker and cap, standing courtside in an arena near empty seats.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: This guy doesn't sign autographs unless they say a specific word.

shots.shows: A young fan holding a marker waiting courtside as Steven Adams walks past.
POV angle from above as Steven Adams approaches the fan and negotiates for the word "please".

ending.last_frame: Steven Adams holding out the signed cap to the fan.

script: This guy doesn't sign autographs unless they say a specific word. Steven Adams! What's up? Will you sign my hat? No. What do you say? What? What do you say? Please! Love it! Thank you! Here ya go mate!
retention_tricks: hook with suspense about the "specific word"
pov angle shift creating intimacy and engagement
comedic standoff between NBA player and fan
what_makes_it_work: Strong hook that establishes a mystery (the specific word)
Humorous interaction featuring a well-known NBA player (Steven Adams)
Satisfying payoff when the fan finally says "please" and gets the autograph
